in_telugu.name: అజిట్
in_telugu.long_meaning: one who is not defeated, invincible

in_marathi.name: Ajit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ajit is derived from the Sanskrit language, where Aji means 'unconquered' and it translates to 'invincible'. It is a popular name in Hindu mythology and culture, often given to boys as a symbol of bravery and strength.

vedic_reference.note: Ajit is the name of the celestial being who was slain by Indra in the Rigveda. The name means 'invincible' and is derived from the Sanskrit root 'aj' (not, not exist).
